# kar-mind

> A persistent, autonomous cognitive stack that composes verified memory organs into one runnable
> system — and structurally cannot publish or spend. No LLM is used as a judge; every check is
> deterministic and re-runnable.

kar-mind wires small, independently-gated memory organs into one mind: it perceives a fact,
cross-checks it against independent sources, consolidates it into meaning, generates new facts and
loops them back, and births new domains — through real organs, with every state change read from each
organ's own count. It remembers itself to a durable, receipt-sealed disk journal (real gzip, a receipt
hash over every field) and comes back whole after a restart. It runs its own loop on its own cadence,
with no caller per step. It cannot publish or spend on its own — the loop has no path to any
irreversible outside-world action, by construction.

## Organs
- crystal: exact facts, no drift, no embeddings — a read never blends one source's value into another's
- octa: verify — cross-checks 3+ independent sources per field, refuses a panel of duplicate sources
- strand: the movement law — recall score, then promote / hold / decay / expire, then the shelf transition
- dodeca: meaning — cosine-embedding retrieval
- icosa: generate — a dream cycle infers new facts from repeated patterns and loops the best back
- tetra: birth — bounded new-domain detection (novelty threshold + hard capacity cap)

## Persistence and autonomy
- Event-sourced: every state-changing verb records its cause; the log is sealed to disk and replayed
  on boot, so the rebuilt mind reaches identical counts. A write-ahead-log persistence architecture.
- The run-loop pulls its own work and drives the full cascade repeatedly from one start; governed by a
  safety cap and a dead-air stop.

## Run
- Clone the three sibling organs (fall-remember, the-dreamer, fallforgecell) next to kar-mind, then:
  `node mind-autonomous-demo.mjs` (boot, run the loop, persist, restart from disk with state intact)
- `node --test` runs the full gate suite. Requires Node 18+; no dependencies.
